                while queue:
                    curr_r, curr_c = queue.pop()
                    component.append((curr_r, curr_c))
                    
                    for nr, nc in [curr_r-1, curr_r+1, curr_c-1, curr_c+1]:
                        pos = (nr, nc)

                    # Also check diagonals for connectivity in 2D patterns
